title: Bulk Update & Add
dangerNote: This feature changes data in Backlog. We recommend trying it on a test project first.
mockNote: Running outside the Wails runtime, so mock data is shown (not real data). Nothing is written to Backlog.
noProfile: No connection profile is selected. Register and select a profile on the Connection screen.
syncRunningNote: An issue sync started on another screen is running. Until it finishes you cannot switch projects, export a template, import Excel, or run a bulk update (you can still view the job history and export results to Excel).

flow.title: Steps
flow.step1: Select a project and export the template Excel file
flow.step2: Fill in the Excel file and load it with "Import Excel" (nothing is written at this point)
flow.step3: Review the validation errors and the dry-run preview
flow.step4: Write to Backlog with "Run" (progress is shown and can be canceled)
flow.step5: Check the result summary (conflicting issues are not overwritten)
flow.step6: If the run was interrupted, resume it from the job history
flow.excelNote: The Excel entry rules (blank = leave unchanged, #CLEAR# to clear, blank issueKey = add new) are described on the "記入方法" (How to fill in) sheet of the template.
flow.customFieldNote: Enter custom fields in the "属性:定義名" (Attribute: definition name) columns (dates as yyyy-MM-dd; multiple lists and checkboxes as comma-separated option names). Values outside the option list (free input for "Other") are not supported yet.

filter.title: Conditions for the issues to export
filter.keywordPlaceholder: Partial match on Issue Key + Summary + Description (separate multiple keywords with spaces)
filter.optionsEmptyNote: Status and Assignee choices are built from synced issues (sync on the Issues screen to make them selectable).
filter.matchNote: Only the issues matching the conditions are included in the template (all blank means all issues).
filter.conditionsNone: No conditions are set, so all issues will be exported.
filter.localDataNote: The search runs against synced local data (filtering by custom field is not supported).

step1.title: ① Export template
step1.projectNote: The project is fixed in the template, so it cannot be changed per row. Issue Type, Status, Priority and Assignee can be edited with the drop-downs in the name columns (rows with an empty name column use the value in the ID column). When a name column has a value it always takes precedence, and a conflicting ID column is ignored with a warning.

step2.title: ② Import Excel
step2.priorityNote: Applied to new rows that have no priority (only for imports in this project).
step2.note: Choose the filled-in Excel file in the file dialog. Importing only validates and runs a dry run; this operation does not write to Backlog.

step3.title: ③ Validation result and change preview (dry run)
step3.validationErrors: {count} validation errors (fix them and import again)
step3.noErrors: There are no validation errors. Review the changes and run.
step3.conflictWarning: {count} issues have been updated remotely since the template was exported. They may be excluded as conflicts when you run.

step4.title: ④ Run
step4.note: Issues are written to Backlog one at a time (there is no bulk API). API calls are spaced by at least one second; a create uses one call and an update uses two including its conflict check. The minimum estimate for the {count} target rows is {estimate} (network and rate-limit waits take additional time).
step4.invalidNote: Cannot run because there are validation errors. Fix the Excel file and import it again.

confirm.title: {count} rows will be written to Backlog. Are you sure?
confirm.force: Remote changes will be overwritten. Changes made remotely to the conflicting issues will be lost.
confirm.resend: Already created issues are checked before resending (duplicate creation is prevented automatically).
confirm.estimate: Minimum estimated time: {estimate} (excluding network and rate-limit waits)

progress.canceling: — Cancellation requested. Will stop after the row being sent finishes.

step5.title: ⑤ Result
step5.skipped: Skipped: {count} (rows with no change at import)
step5.skippedNote: Skipped counts the rows judged as "no change" at import. Rows left unprocessed by a cancellation or an interruption are not included. Check the warnings below and the Pending / Sending columns of the job history for unprocessed rows.
step5.conflictNote: {count} conflicts: the remote side has been updated. Review the latest state, then choose "Overwrite conflicts and run again" to force an overwrite.
step5.exportNote: Exports the per-row result (done, failed, conflict, error details) to Excel.

resultExport.title: Result report export
resultExport.canceled: The result report export was canceled.
resultExport.done: Exported the result report for job #{jobId} ({rows} rows)

step6.title: ⑥ Job history
step6.empty: There is no run history yet.
step6.sendingNote: The send result of some rows could not be confirmed ({count} rows). Resuming processes them after checking (they are matched against the already created issues, so duplicate creation is prevented automatically).
step6.rowsEmpty: There are no row details for this job.

action.resumeResend: Resume and resend the sending rows
